description_en: Associates auditors with an audit policy
description_zh: 绑定审计员到审计规则
name: AttachReviewersToReviewRule

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host instance.
You can call the DescribeInstances operation to obtain the bastion host instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
可通过调用DescribeInstances接口获取堡垒机实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
Region ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the audit policy.
You can call the ListReviewRules operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
审计规则ID。
您可以调用ListReviewRules接口获取该参数
parameters.name: review_rule_id

fields.help_en: When PrincipalType is set to RamUser, specify the RAM user ID of the auditor to associate. When PrincipalType is set to RamRole, specify the RAM role ARN of the auditor to associate
fields.help_zh: 当 PrincipalType 取值为 RamUser 时，传入需要关联的审计员的 RAM 用户 ID。当 PrincipalType 取值为 RamRole 时，传入需要关联的审计员的 RAM 角色 ARN
fields.name: principal_id

fields.help_en: The display name of the associated auditor's RAM user or RAM role
fields.help_zh: 关联的审计员的 RAM 用户/RAM 角色显示名称
fields.name: principal_name

fields.help_en:
The type of the auditor to associate. Valid values:

RamUser: Resource Access Management (RAM) user.

RamRole: RAM role
fields.help_zh:
要关联的审计员类型。取值：

RamUser：RAM用户。

RamRole：RAM角色
fields.name: principal_type

parameters.help_en: The information about the auditors associated with the audit policy
parameters.help_zh: 审计规则中关联的审计员信息
parameters.name: principals

RequestId.description_en: The unique request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
